title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/AWS)
jd_text:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing team. You will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems serving millions of requests daily.

## Responsibilities:
- Design and implement high-performance REST APIs using Python
- Architect microservices on AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3)
- Optimize database queries and implement caching strategies (PostgreSQL, Redis)
- Write clean, maintainable code with comprehensive unit tests
- Collaborate with frontend engineers and product teams
- Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
- Participate in on-call rotation for production support

## Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python (3.8+)
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL and relational databases
- Hands-on AWS experience (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFormation)
- Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes nice-to-have)
- Understanding of distributed systems and microservices architecture
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
- Strong communication and teamwork abilities

## Nice-to-Have:
- Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
- Knowledge of GraphQL
- Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code
- Open source contributions
- Prior experience scaling systems to high throughput

## Location: Remote (US/Canada preferred, open to globals)
## Compensation: $150k-$200k + equity
